title: One-day website + funnel Skill ship for local
one_liner: Productize a same-day Skill+Claude Code build: full site, lead magnets, email capture, and marketing funnel for one boring local business.
why_agent_runnable: Site/funnel scaffolding, copy, lead-magnet drafts, and delivery checklists are agent-native via Skills. Brandon picks client, gates money/publish/send, and does live demos if needed.

ops_steps.title: Offer + niche packaging
ops_steps.detail: Lock one-day SKU: site + lead magnet + email capture + funnel; draft pricing tiers and scope fence.

ops_steps.title: Prospect shortlist
ops_steps.detail: Find locals with weak/no site but proven demand (reviews, Maps); score for one-day fit.

ops_steps.title: Brandon client + price pick
ops_steps.detail: Choose first design-partner client and approve quote.

ops_steps.title: Skill ship build day
ops_steps.detail: Draft full site, lead magnet, capture forms, email sequences using Skills stack — staging only until publish gate.

ops_steps.title: Publish + domain gate
ops_steps.detail: Approve domain, go-live, analytics, and any paid hosting/email tools.

ops_steps.title: Handoff + case study draft
ops_steps.detail: Delivery checklist, Loom walkthrough script, case-study draft (publish gate); propose retainer upsell.

ops_steps.title: Productize SOP
ops_steps.detail: Lock one-day runbook; propose next 5 identical ships or kill if delivery overruns.

human_only_checkpoints: Any purchase, deposit, ad spend, or paid tool upgrade
Hiring contractors, VAs, or licensed trades
Publishing listings, sites, ads, social as official
Physical pickup, delivery, install, or on-site work

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs/Craigslist job posts, contractor shortlists, SOWs, and payment memos in plan drafts only.
brandon_gates_before_money: approve recurring retainer or inventory buy

unit_economics_sketch.tool_cost_notes: Hosting/email/domain usually low double-digits to low hundreds/mo
unit_economics_sketch.gross_margin_notes: Margin is mostly time; overruns kill the model. Creator $30-40k/mo anecdote is not a Brandon target. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
unit_economics_sketch.disclaimer: No income guarantees. Creator anecdotes ≠ your results.

first_7_day_agent_sprint: Day 1: package one-day SKU + pricing draft
Day 2-3: prospect shortlist with weak-site evidence
Day 6-7: Brandon publish gate + case-study draft
kill_criteria: Builds consistently exceed one working day after 3 ships
No paying client after 20 Brandon-approved outreaches
Clients refuse to provide assets/photos within 48h
Brandon declines further publish or paid tool spend
disclaimer: Research plan only. Not financial, legal, or investment advice. No income guarantees. Brandon approval required before money, hire, pay, publish, or send.
